notes: Fig. 2.10 is a schematic plan of the whole city drawn to show ratios and proportions: walls as orange bands, excavated stretches as dark blocks, reservoirs as blue outlines, the rivers as triple blue lines and tumuli as rings. The embedded image is rotated on the page; to identify features it was viewed turned a quarter turn clockwise so that the drawn north arrow points up (crops/dholdossier_p0023_rot_cw_VIEWONLY.png, viewing only); every plan pixel above refers to the unrotated render named in plans-v1.json. Points were read on the current Esri image (Vantor Vivid, 2023-12-18, 0.5 m), the same mosaic as the other Dholavira plans. The drawing gives lengths and ratios of walls and diagonals; it carries a north arrow, but no statement of a wall's or the town's orientation was read.
